title: Programmable fill defaults to 45°
description: A new programmable fill on a 40 × 40 mm square is sewn at the guide's default direction, 45°: the stitch direction carrying the most length is 45° ±1° (angles measured from +x towards +y, the file's y axis pointing down), and the stored angle is 45.

evidence.note: the programmable fill example is captioned "45° (default)"

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw a 40 × 40 mm square at (10, 10) mm. Line sewing off; set the region sew type to Programmable Fill Stitch without changing the direction or the pattern from their defaults (record the pattern name). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
